Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

Slow a target for a fixed duration, no matter what it does.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or become slowed 1 for the duration (slowed 2 on a critical failure). This slowed value doesn't tick down early — it lasts the full duration regardless of what the target does. Some things simply take as long as they take.
